pumac-2020-algebra-a-07.prompt: Suppose that $p$ is the unique monic polynomial of minimal degree such that its coefficients are rational numbers and one of its roots is $\sin\frac{2\pi}{7}+\cos\frac{4\pi}{7}$. If $p(1)=\frac ab$, where $a,b$ are relatively prime integers, find $|a+b|$.

pumac-2020-algebra-a-08.prompt: Let $a_n$ be the number of unordered sets of three distinct bijections $f,g,h:\{1,2,\dots,n\}\to\{1,2,\dots,n\}$ such that the composition of any two of the bijections equals the third. What is the largest value in the sequence $a_1,a_2,\dots$ which is less than $2021$?
